primary.name: ordered_prefix_dependence_after_fixed_chase
primary.estimand: G_s(i) = log(FID50k_NFE1(BA(s), t=s+512)) - log(FID50k_NFE1(CTRL, t=s+512)), s in {128,256,384,512}

test.name: Page ordered-alternatives test
test.rank_rule: larger Z receives larger rank; ties receive average ranks
test.p_value: exact null distribution for actual complete-seed count and four treatments

report: per-point mean median sample_SD two-sided_95pct_Student_t_CI sign_counts
Page statistic and exact one-sided p
descriptive adjacent paired differences with mean and 95pct_CI

missing_data.primary: complete-case across the eight primary cells; n=9..12 runs the unchanged four-point primary; n<9 aborts primary
missing_data.secondary_only_failure: does not remove a primary-complete seed; report actual n_s
missing_data.arm_concentration: at least three failures in one switch arm is DIFFERENTIAL_ARM_FAILURE; no three-point primary

claim_ceiling: Ordered dependence on B-prefix duration along the schedules tested after a fixed 512-kimg A chase; no early-writing, dose-accumulation, memory-decay, mediation, or generalization claim.

allowed_wording.ORDERED_PREFIX_DEPENDENCE: After a fixed 512-kimg A chase, the BA-versus-A log-FID contrast showed the prespecified ordered dependence on B-prefix duration across the four schedules tested, with longer prefixes associated with a more negative contrast.
allowed_wording.ORDERING_NOT_RESOLVED: The fresh cohort did not resolve the prespecified ordered dependence on B-prefix duration; the four point estimates and intervals are reported descriptively.
allowed_wording.common_endpoint: At the common 1024-kimg endpoint, the prespecified BA-versus-A contrasts were [values and intervals]; these descriptive contrasts combine differences in B-prefix and subsequent A-chase duration.

downstream_boundaries.TASK1: Compare TASK2 H_512 only with TASK1 descriptive H_A, side by side with no pooling or test; TASK1 primary H remains INCONCLUSIVE.
downstream_boundaries.PR96: Report TASK2 H_512-H_384 beside the analogous PR96 pulse contrast descriptively; independent seeds and different common-A chase horizons preclude pooling or verdict revision.

postseal_companion.quantity: paired log-FID contrast for seed81 BA512@1024 minus CTRL@1024 across five non-overlapping generation blocks
